In this markdown, we create a WNN of the integrated protein and RNA data

```{r}
library("Seurat")
library("ggplot2")
```

Load in data
```{r}
rna_obj <- readRDS("C:/Users/irc/Desktop/Internship Bioinformatics 2025-2026/Lode/Harmony/Harmony_RNA_integrated.rds")
protein_obj <- readRDS("C:/Users/irc/Desktop/Internship Bioinformatics 2025-2026/Lode/Harmony/Harmony_protein_integrated.rds") # has 3 proteins already removed
```

Join the 2 datasets

```{r}
# Copy the ADT assay into the RNA object
SeuratobjectMulti <- rna_obj
SeuratobjectMulti[["ADT"]] <- protein_obj[["ADT"]]

# Copy the ADT Harmony reduction into the RNA object
# (Replace 'harmony' or 'harmony_adt' with whatever your protein reduction is named inside protein_obj)
adt_harmony_reduction_name <- "ADT_harmony" # Check via names(protein_obj@reductions)

SeuratobjectMulti[["ADT_harmony"]] <- protein_obj[[adt_harmony_reduction_name]]
# this block throws a warning because rna_obj also has an ADT assay, which is overwritten 
```

Perform WNN
```{r}

SeuratobjectMulti <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(
  SeuratobjectMulti, 
  reduction.list = list("RNA_harmony", "ADT_harmony"), 
  dims.list = list(1:30, 1:10), 
  modality.weight.name = "RNA.weight"
)
```

Clustering and visualization

```{r}
SeuratobjectMulti <- RunUMAP(SeuratobjectMulti,
                             nn.name = "weighted.nn",
                             reduction.name = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq",
                             reduction.key = "wnnUMAPciteseq_")

SeuratobjectMulti <- FindClusters(SeuratobjectMulti, 
                                  graph.name = "wsnn",
                                  algorithm = 3, 
                                  resolution = 1, 
                                  verbose = TRUE)

```

Create plot
```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, dpi=300}
# Plot UMAP colored by batch/treatment variables
p1 <- DimPlot(SeuratobjectMulti, reduction = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq", group.by = "treatment") + 
  ggtitle("Harmony_CITEseq: treatment")

p2 <- DimPlot(SeuratobjectMulti, reduction = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq", group.by = "experiment") + 
  ggtitle("Harmony_CITEseq: experiment")

p3 <- DimPlot(SeuratobjectMulti, reduction = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("Harmony_CITEseq: Clusters")

p4 <- DimPlot(SeuratobjectMulti, reduction = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq", group.by = "celltype_new", label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("Harmony_CITEseq: celltype")

p5 <- DimPlot(SeuratobjectMulti, reduction = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq", group.by = "tech", label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("Harmony_CITEseq: tech")

p1
p2
p3
p4
p5
```

Write out 

```{r}
saveRDS(SeuratobjectMulti,"C:/Users/irc/Desktop/Internship Bioinformatics 2025-2026/Lode/Harmony/Harmony_RNA_protein_integrated_WNN.rds")
```

More visualizations:
Now make a dotplot to verify the clusters
```{r}
markers <- list(
  "Pre_cDC1"       = c("Ccr2", "Fcer1g", "Cd24a", "Vim"), 
  "Early_Immature" = c("Sell", "Creld2", "Pdia4"),
  "Late_Immature"  = c("Cd207", "Itgae", "Apol7c", "Apoe", "Dnase1l3", "Cadm1", "Xcr1", "Cd83", "Cd86"), 
  "Early_Mature"   = c("Cxcl10", "Cxcl9", "Iigp1", "Ifi47", "Gbp2", "Gbp5", "Cd40"),
  "Late_Mature"    = c("Cd63", "Fscn1", "Il4i1", "Socs2", "Ccr7")
)
```
Make the plot itself
```{r}
DotPlot(SeuratobjectMulti, features = markers, group.by = "seurat_clusters") + 
  RotatedAxis() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(x = "Markers", y = "Clusters / Cell Types")
```

Multi-page report: 
```{r}
library(patchwork)

pdf("cDC1_Marker_Expression_Summary_CITEseq.pdf", width = 11, height = 8.5)

for (subset_name in names(markers)) {
  
  gene_list  <- markers[[subset_name]]
  gene_count <- length(gene_list)
  
  # Determine grid dimensions to keep panel sizes uniform
  if (gene_count <= 3) {
    num_cols <- 3
    num_rows <- 1
  } else if (gene_count <= 6) {
    num_cols <- 3
    num_rows <- 2
  } else {
    num_cols <- 3
    num_rows <- 3
  }
  
  # 1. Create the base FeaturePlot
  p <- FeaturePlot(
    SeuratobjectMulti,
    features  = gene_list,
    ncol      = num_cols,
    reduction = "wnn.umap_CITE_seq"
  ) & 
  # Force 1:1 aspect ratio so UMAPs stay square, never stretched
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text    = element_text(size = 7)
  )
  
  # 2. Enforce explicit row/column dimensions with patchwork
  p_formatted <- p + 
    plot_layout(ncol = num_cols, nrow = num_rows) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = paste("Subset:", subset_name),
      subtitle = paste("Genes:", paste(gene_list, collapse = ", ")),
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", color = "#1A365D"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#4A5568", face = "italic")
      )
    )
  
  print(p_formatted)
}

dev.off()
```
